tasks.short: Select insulation with suitable thermal characteristics

steps.what: Read the actual thermal requirements and material constraints for the pipe, duct or equipment
inputs: actual approved job specifications
actual equipment and service conditions

steps.what: Find and compare actual approved insulation material data against the required thermal characteristics
inputs: worker-checked insulation selection requirements
actual manufacturer data and approved material catalogue
outputs: source-checked candidate material characteristics and exclusions

steps.what: Check actual site fit and practical constraints affecting the candidate insulation
inputs: source-checked candidate material characteristics and exclusions
actual location, surface and equipment conditions

steps.what: Select and finish checking the exact insulation choice and its source specification in the existing job material field
inputs: worker's checked site-fit considerations
source-checked candidate material characteristics and exclusions
worker-checked insulation selection requirements
outputs: complete checked insulation selection for the actual job

steps.what: Save the checked selection in the same job record without placing an order
inputs: complete checked insulation selection for the actual job

tasks.design: Configure native filters in {OTHER}, the actual approved material catalogue, using documented thermal properties. The worker checks {DOCS} source data and real site fit, chooses the material and records it in {OPS_SYSTEM}; a filter match does not certify suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing approved material data can require repeated catalogue navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue fields can filter actual documented characteristics.
tasks.still_hard: Match the material to actual service and site constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a superficially matching material is inappropriate.

ambition.what: Reduce catalogue navigation without automatic material selection.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: insulation selection uses documented material properties and actual job conditions; catalogue filters can narrow candidates but do not establish suitability.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the existing job material record. Specification owners and manufacturers produce source data; worker reads actual requirements and checks site fit. No invented product, thermal value or structured site input.
Native catalogue filtering first. Existing catalogue metadata is required; new tagging is not free. The task records selection only, not procurement, installation or compliance certification.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 6 minus 0.5 filter upkeep gives 5.5 net. Choice/record authoring and the 1% same-system save remain fully retained.
unknowns: Actual catalogue fields, current search effort and job-record requirements
research_questions: Can native filters reduce navigation while keeping source exclusions and site-fit checks visible?

approvals.approved_version: complete exact insulation selection checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if filters already used or metadata absent; cautious range below provisional 5.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine insulation quantities, types and installation methods

steps.what: Read approved drawings and measure actual lengths, diameters, shapes, locations and equipment access needed for takeoff
inputs: actual approved drawings
actual surfaces and equipment conditions
outputs: worker-measured takeoff geometry with units and unresolved dimensions

steps.what: Determine suitable insulation types and installation methods from actual location, surface shape and equipment use
inputs: worker-measured takeoff geometry with units and unresolved dimensions
approved material requirements and actual equipment use
outputs: worker-selected material types, installation methods and explicit takeoff allowances

steps.what: Calculate insulation amounts from checked geometry and explicit material/allowance rules, leaving unresolved shapes for manual handling
inputs: worker-measured takeoff geometry with units and unresolved dimensions
worker-selected material types, installation methods and explicit takeoff allowances
approved quantity formulas and unit conversions
outputs: calculated material quantities with source dimensions, units and exception flags

steps.what: Verify calculated quantities against actual sections and complete the takeoff with types, methods and unresolved exceptions
inputs: calculated material quantities with source dimensions, units and exception flags
worker-measured takeoff geometry with units and unresolved dimensions
worker-selected material types, installation methods and explicit takeoff allowances

steps.what: Save the checked takeoff in the same workbook without ordering materials
inputs: complete checked insulation quantity/type/method takeoff

tasks.design: Use fixed takeoff formulas in {SPREADSHEET} on the worker's actual measured geometry and explicit allowances. The worker determines material and method, verifies quantities and records exceptions; no model guesses dimensions, fittings or waste factors.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated quantity arithmetic can duplicate measured dimensions and agreed calculation rules.
tasks.enabler_now: A formula workbook can calculate supported geometry with units and traceable inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Measure real conditions and choose methods for awkward surfaces and access.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize an incomplete takeoff or a shape not covered by the formula.

ambition.what: Remove repeated arithmetic while retaining measurement and method judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: material takeoffs use measured geometry, explicit allowances and unit arithmetic; formulas can reproduce calculations without choosing installation methods.

assumptions: Worker produces actual geometry and units in s1 and explicit material/method/allowance choices in s2. New structured workbook entry beyond existing measurement notes is incremental, not hidden free capture.

Native takeoff software first if already available; otherwise fixed spreadsheet formulas, no language model. Unsupported fittings, missing dimensions or unclear units stay flagged for manual resolution; no inferred complete takeoff.

Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 25 minus 2 additional structured entry and 1 formula upkeep gives 22 net. Measurement, final checks and 1% same-system save remain; an existing equivalent calculator receives no new saving.
unknowns: Actual geometry coverage, current calculator use and extra structured-entry burden
research_questions: Can formulas reduce actual arithmetic after counting geometry capture and checks on fittings and allowances?

already_counted.description: Verify quantities and complete actual takeoff

incremental.description: Structure measured geometry beyond existing notes

approvals.approved_version: complete quantity/type/method takeoff checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if calculator already used or capture overhead erases arithmetic gains; cautious range below provisional 22% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read blueprints and specifications to determine job requirements

steps.what: Confirm the actual job and applicable approved drawing/specification revision
inputs: actual job identity
controlled drawing and specification register
outputs: worker-confirmed applicable document set and revision

steps.what: Locate relevant pipe/duct sheets, sections, insulation details and specification clauses
inputs: worker-confirmed applicable document set and revision
existing controlled document index and bookmarks
outputs: located actual relevant sheets and clauses

steps.what: Read and interpret actual drawings, symbols, dimensions and specification requirements, resolving contradictions explicitly
inputs: located actual relevant sheets and clauses
worker-confirmed applicable document set and revision
outputs: worker's understood actual job requirements and unresolved questions

tasks.design: Configure native sheet and specification bookmarks in {DOCS} for the controlled document set. The worker checks the revision and reads the original detail; navigation aids do not summarize away conflicting dimensions or determine installation requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding relevant sheets and clauses can require repeated document navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed viewers and existing document bookmarks can shorten source navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Interpret drawings and reconcile actual specification contradictions.
tasks.human_edge: Know which unresolved detail requires clarification.

ambition.what: Reduce navigation while retaining original drawing interpretation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled drawing viewers support indexes and bookmarks; workers still interpret actual symbols, dimensions and specification requirements.

assumptions: Document control produces the approved document set and index. Worker checks revision in s1 and source details in s3. No new OCR coordinate extraction, structured geometry capture or invented drawing content.

Native viewer bookmarks first. This reading task establishes no separate written job report or send; actual annotations or clarification requests, if required locally, need their own authoring and gated save/send rather than being hidden here.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 2 minus 0.3 bookmark upkeep gives 1.7 net. Substantive reading and interpretation remain fully retained.
unknowns: Current viewer navigation and actual document-control quality
research_questions: Can native bookmarks reduce sheet navigation while preserving revision checks and original detail reading?

already_counted.description: Check located sheets and specification clauses

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native navigation already adequate; cautious range below provisional 1.7% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Specification owners and document control supply approved requirements; workers retain actual measurement and material/method decisions.

Keep incomplete geometry and specification conflicts explicit
role.ambitious_version: Reduce verified document navigation and repeated takeoff arithmetic while preserving real-site measurement and insulation judgement.
